feature: Animator-authored four-paw contact intervals for generated Rigify quadrupeds

acceptance.position: Every enabled paw remains within 0.0002 of its body-to-paw reference distance at validation samples
acceptance.orientation: Enabled paw orientation locks remain within 0.001 radians at validation samples
acceptance.sampling: Editable linear fit keys use at most 0.25-frame spacing and validation uses at most 0.125-frame spacing
acceptance.workflow: Correction copies the Pose Blending candidate; Restore Before Contacts, Discard and Restore Source preserve the retained inputs
acceptance.priority: Captured priority poses are unchanged; conflicting contacts fail before committing output
acceptance.recovery: A kept corrected candidate survives save/reload and restores its source action
acceptance.guards: Cancellation, rotation locks, active constraints, drivers, changed requests and unsupported rigs fail without mutating the input
acceptance.offline: The exact package runs with outbound Python calls denied

qualified: Generated Rigify cat, horse and wolf four-paw contact correction
Animator-authored contact points, intervals, blend, strength and optional orientation locks
Quarter-frame editable fitting with eighth-frame validation
Cancellation, copied-candidate recovery and source restoration
Save/reload recovery for a kept corrected candidate
not_qualified: Automatic quadruped contact or gait inference
Quadruped balance, flight, arbitrary surfaces or collision physics
Quadruped learned posing or learned motion
Direct metarig, imported or custom quadruped correction
